dataset_name: Rice Suitability Project Examples with DOA Improved-AWD Reference

source.title: Improved Alternate Wetting and Drying Technique in Rice Cultivation
source.role: Irrigation guidance reference only; not source of the example suitability labels

feature_schema.soil_moisture_7: fraction 0 to 1; sensor calibration and depth must be documented
feature_schema.suitability_score: project-defined ordinal label 1 to 5, not DOA validated

awd_reference.note: Water depth below soil surface is not equivalent to volumetric soil moisture fraction. Apply only with crop-stage and field context.

training_warning: Three illustrative labeled rows are insufficient for scientifically meaningful classifier training or evaluation. Do not report accuracy from these as field-validated.
